title: LEGACY_SERVED_PATHS -- every served path below {source}/{scope}/platinum/ that the frozen portal requests (NAMING_SCHEMA.json v1.4 key.legacy_served_paths)
claim: MEASURED -- read from portal source at portal_vintage; every entry cites its request site in request_sites
portal_vintage_basis: git ls-tree HEAD portal in worktree wk-lgic-naming-1-1 at workspace HEAD 6a5b276f8b prints 160000 commit e85f6eb84f3a1771a37011a7e77e372570bad02a portal; read READ-ONLY with git -C <workspace>/portal show <sha>:<path>
key_form: Each entry is a key template below the bucket in the ruled grammar {source}/{scope}/{tier}/{table}/{partition}[/{object}]. A {placeholder} stands for any value of one segment, or of the part of a segment it occupies. The bytes below {source}/{scope}/platinum/ are the bytes the portal requests; they are kept (key.legacy_served_path). The source is the family's product: advi for the advisor-intelligence router family (the D8 vector key('advi','49financial','platinum','firm','header_metrics.json')), mdpf for /api/general/mdpf/*, etfs for the positioning and satellites reads (satelliteRegistry.ts:3 names ETFS_SATELLITES). {scope} is the firm or product the bucket serves, in the LONG form.

mapping./api/scoped/advisor-intelligence/platinu: platinum/<tail> in the caller's firm bucket (satelliteRegistry.ts:35-37, adviKeyRepoint.ts:21-33) -> advi/{scope}/platinum/<tail>
mapping./api/scoped/partners/books/advisor/{id}/: Lambda routes; the portal names the key each reads at the call site (advisor-intelligence.ts:952 summary.json, :467 mix.json) -> advi/{scope}/platinum/advisors/{advisor_id}/<leaf>
mapping./api/scoped/satellites/registry.json: platinum/satellites/registry.json in the requesting firm's bucket (satelliteRegistry.ts:74-76) -> etfs/{scope}/platinum/satellites/registry.json
mapping./api/general/mdpf/{firmId}/<leaf>: the public-data-router rewrite /api/general/mdpf/* -> platinum/mdpf/* in opal-data-portal-v2 (aum.ts:509, portal-proxy.ts:522-523) -> mdpf/{scope}/platinum/<leaf>

census.named_instrument: git -C <workspace>/portal grep -n platinum e85f6eb84f -- src: 122 lines (case-sensitive). It does not see request lines built on PLATINUM_BASE, advisorBase, clientBase or perfrpLeafBase, nor the /api/general/* routes the router rewrites to platinum/ (row LGIC_NAMING-W1-S1).
census.widened: git grep -n -i platinum e85f6eb84f -- src: 401 lines across 33 files; git grep -n -E 'api/general/mdpf|PLATINUM_BASE|platinum-summary|/api/scoped/[a-z-]+/platinum' e85f6eb84f -- src: 47 lines; git grep -n -E 'drilldown_summary|mix.json|/api/scoped/satellites|/api/general/(mdpf|etfs)|advisors/${|clients/${|accounts/${' e85f6eb84f -- src: 30 lines; every distinct platinum path string in the 401 lines extracted and resolved to a request site or an exclusion below
